bins.description:
FLOW-002 media organization (ADR-0129): unordered bin collection keyed
by `Bin.id`. An asset may appear in several bins.

export_presets.description:
FLOW-003 shared export presets (ADR-0130): versioned, destination-free
`render.submit` settings stored inside the document.

multicams.description: NLE-007 multicam groups (ADR-0127); plain entries, never opaque.

proxies.description:
Original → preview-proxy linkage (ADR-0119); never affects authored
media identity or export resolution.

scene_boundary_assets.description:
AI-002 (ADR-0125): deterministic cut-detection results, locked to the
analyzed source asset like tracking data.

AngleId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

AnimationCurve.description:
Validated, strictly time-ordered document data; evaluation lives in
kronello-animation. Unknown meaning versions can be retained and serialized,
but cannot be edited or evaluated as version 1. Empty curves are editable;
evaluating one is an explicit error, never an implicit default value.

AnimatorMode.description:
Per-animation-unit value distribution. `step` applies the evaluated value
unchanged, `ramp` blends linearly over the selected units in reading order,
`follow` keeps the first selected unit at full effect and trails later units
by `follow_smoothing`, and `random` draws a stable seeded factor per unit.

AssetId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

bands.description: Inclusive low / exclusive high frequencies, in Hz.

time_map.description: Consumer-local time maps to the absolute analysed sample grid.

beat.description: Thresholded onset with a fixed 100 ms refractory interval, not tempo inference.

onset.description: Positive RMS difference from the preceding analysis window.

oneOf.description: Canonical fixed Project snapshot hash, target id and evaluator version.

AudioRetimePolicy.description: NLE-001 never performs implicit pitch/speed conversion.

assets.description:
Insertion-ordered membership. The list behaves like an ordered set:
membership edits assign each asset at most once.

BinId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

BoundsStage.description: Resolution-independent bounds stage selected by a layout consumer.

CaptionAnchor.description: Nine-direction anchor inside the caption safe area.

CaptionDocument.description:
Versioned cue document. One `CaptionDocument` describes exactly one cue's
text, style and placement; its timeline interval lives on the caption clip.

spans.description: Ordered, nonoverlapping span overrides at grapheme boundaries.

text.description:
Cue payload text. `\n` is the only line separator and the content is
data: import decoders strip markup, and nothing here is executed.

version.description: Supported document version; this implementation accepts only 1.

CaptionFormat.description:
Import provenance of a cue document. Export always reserializes the stored
document; this metadata never drives rendering.

CaptionId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

CaptionOutline.description: Stroke drawn outside the glyph fill, in the sequence working color space.

width.description:
Visible outline ring width in design_px; zero is allowed but draws
nothing. Rendering strokes the glyph path centered at twice this width.

CaptionPlacement.description:
Nine-direction caption placement relative to the sequence safe area.
Ratios are stored exactly as rationals, never as floating point.

offset.description:
Additional offset from the anchor point, as a ratio of the sequence
extent. +x moves right, +y moves down.

safe_area_inset.description:
Inset applied to both sides of the sequence extent per axis, as a ratio
of that extent. Each component must be in `0..=1/2`.

CaptionSpan.description:
Span-level style override. Unknown attributes are rejected by strict
decoding instead of being silently dropped.

bold.description: Drawn as a synthesized stroke when no replacement span font is given.

font.description: Explicit replacement face; its bytes remain hash-locked.

italic.description:
Drawn as a synthesized oblique shear when no replacement span font is
given. Both flags are draw-time attributes of the span, not markup.

CaptionStyle.description:
Cue-wide base style. Span attributes override these values inside their
text range only.

background.description: Optional rectangle behind the laid-out cue block.

fill.description: Straight tagged color evaluated in the sequence working space.

font.description: Hash-locked face; rendering never substitutes family/system fonts.

CharacterAnimation.description: Logical source selection. Ranges are never glyph or line indices.

expected_text.description: Exact unnormalized source captured when the selector is authored.

follow_smoothing.description:
Scalar in [0, 1], dimensionless; required when `mode` is `follow`.
0.0 delegates to `step`; larger values trail later units more.

rotation.description: Angle per-unit rotation in degrees about the glyph anchor.

scale.description: Vec2 per-unit scale factors, dimensionless; 1.0 is neutral.

seed.description: Fixed seed for `random`; absent seeds still hash to stable factors.

enabled.description:
Authored contribution switch. Disabled clips keep their timeline
occupancy, links and metadata but are excluded from evaluation, video
compositing, audio mixing, captions and transitions. Serialized only
when off so documents written before NLE-005 roundtrip unchanged.

markers.description: Sequence-time annotations, confined to this placement's range.

masks.description:
FX-004 clip-local Bezier mask stack (ADR-0114). Masks multiply clip
alpha after content drawing and before `effects`; empty on old documents.

pan.description:
GUI-012 (ADR-0138): constant stereo balance in [-1, 1], absent means
center. Applied to the clip's mixed output after volume, effects and
fades; the basic (pre-AUDIO-004) mixer rejects it as unsupported.

properties.description: Placement transform and effect parameters, evaluated in sequence time.

volume.description: Absent in M2 documents means unity. Evaluated in source-local time.

ColorComponents.description:
Straight RGB with independent alpha. Alpha defaults only at input; saved

Composition.description:
Editable document frame. After editing or decoding, validate the complete

order has no semantic meaning; root_nodes and child_order carry draw order.

input_bindings.description:

color.description: Straight authoring color composited at the transition midpoint.

Duration.description: A nonnegative length in seconds. Zero is permitted.

Effect.description: Unknown ids, parameters, fields and variants are retained verbatim.

oneOf.description:
AUDIO-007 parametric EQ. `bands` references a data table property
with `kind` (peak | low_shelf | high_shelf), `freq_hz`, `gain_db`
and `q` columns and 1..=AUDIO_EQ_MAX_BANDS rows.
AUDIO-007 Butterworth high-pass; `order` is 1..=AUDIO_FILTER_MAX_ORDER.
AUDIO-007 Butterworth low-pass; `order` is 1..=AUDIO_FILTER_MAX_ORDER.
AUDIO-008 stereo-linked feed-forward peak compressor.
AUDIO-008 ceiling limiter with instant attack and release.

COLOR-002 exposure: premultiplied working RGB is scaled by
2^exposure and shifted by offset; alpha is preserved (ADR-0108).
COLOR-002 levels with gamma, applied per premultiplied RGB channel.

COLOR-002 monotone-cubic RGB channel curve. The property is a data
table with scalar `x` and `y` columns, `x` strictly increasing, both
in [0,1], and at most CURVES_MAX_POINTS rows.
COLOR-002 hue/saturation/lightness in working HSL; alpha preserved.

saturation.description: Multiplier where 1.0 leaves saturation unchanged; finite scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-005 chroma key (ADR-0115): alpha = keyed Cb/Cr matte, then edge
shrink/feather adjust the matte and `spill` suppresses the key hue.

edge_feather.description: Matte Gaussian feather sigma in design_px.

similarity.description: Cb/Cr distance that maps to full transparency; 0..=1.

oneOf.description:
FX-005 luma key (ADR-0115): working-space luminance distance drives
the alpha matte, then edge shrink/feather adjust it.

edge_feather.description: Matte Gaussian feather sigma in design_px.

key_luma.description: Straight-color luminance that becomes fully transparent; 0..=1.

tolerance.description: Luminance distance that maps to full opacity; 0..=1.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 glow (ADR-0115): straight luminance above `threshold` is
extracted, blurred by a Gaussian of sigma `radius`, and added back.

intensity.description: Additive contribution of the blurred bloom; nonnegative scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 unsharp mask (ADR-0115): out = source + amount * (source -
blur(source)); the alpha channel participates and stays in [0,1].

FX-006 vignette (ADR-0115): darkens RGB toward the image corners;
alpha is preserved.

feather.description: Smoothstep width of the falloff; nonnegative scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 corner pin (ADR-0115): the four corners of the incoming
surface's bounds are moved to these absolute Composition design_px
positions, in order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

COLOR-003 3D `.cube` LUT (ADR-0113). `lut` references an
`AssetKind::Data` asset whose content bytes parse as a normalized
`CubeLut`; the document stores the reference, never expanded bytes.
`intensity` blends identity into the sampled output on 0..=1. Alpha is
preserved and the authored stack order is honored.

AUDIO-011 (ADR-0131): hash-pinned audio plugin binding. The document
carries only identity + pin metadata — a bundle path string, format,
component id, manifest hash and version — never plugin bytes. The
binding is processed exclusively by the detached plugin worker; the
audio evaluator rejects it with `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`.

bundle.description: Bundle directory or module file path.

component.description: VST3 32-hex class id or AU `type:subtype:manufacturer` triplet.

parameters.description:
DataTable `{ param: Scalar, value: Scalar }` — VST3 normalized
parameter ids, AU native parameter values; ≤1024 rows.

plugin_version.description:
Recorded plugin version pin (AU hex version / VST3 class
version string; empty = unpinned).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 manifest pin (empty for built-in AUs).

oneOf.description:
TRACK-002 (ADR-0122): invert tracked camera motion. `tracking`
references a `TrackingDataAsset`; the smoothed trajectory uses a
symmetric window of `2*smoothing_radius+1` tracked samples;
`max_displacement` (design px), `max_rotation` (degrees) and
`max_crop` (unit interval of the source frame area) bound the applied
correction; `border` selects the uncovered-region policy with
`fill_color` for `fill`; `sampling` picks the resampler.

layout_constraints.description: Dynamic text bounds rules survive template input materialization.

noise_aliases.description: Fresh copied nested identities retain their original noise coordinate.

simulation_aliases.description: Copied simulation emitters retain their original event identity.

ExportOutput.description:
Mirror of `kronello_service::JobOutput`; the same `"format"` tag, snake_case
variant names, field names and field defaults are required for the
one-to-one conversion at submission time.

oneOf.description: Subtitle sidecar file; the target must be the same sequence.

ExportPreset.description:
A versioned, named, destination-independent export setting stored in the
project document. `destination` is supplied per submission, never stored.

composition.description:
Legacy single-composition shortcut; exactly one of `composition` and
`target` must be set, matching the `RenderInput` rule.

required_features.description: Submission-time capability requirements, forwarded to the job request.

ExportPresetId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

nodes.description: Ordered postorder tree; the last node is the root. No sharing or dead nodes.

ExpressionId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description: Seconds in the authored source scope, after its rational time mapping.
Stable property in the authored source scope; None means composition input.
Integer row operand and statically typed column in immutable table data.

Nonnegative lookback seconds on the root timeline, quantized to 1 ns.
Static identity remains a dependency even when sampling the past.
Explicit rational offset.
Radians, explicitly dimensionless scalar input.
Quintic interpolation between adjacent fixed lattice hashes in [-1, 1].
Fixed hash noise in [-1, 1], keyed by seed, instance, element and input.

color.description: Color Property: explicitly tagged straight RGB and independent alpha.

FiniteF64.description: No non-finite value can be constructed or deserialized through the public API.

FlowFallbackPolicy.description:
TRACK-003 (ADR-0123): the explicit failure policy authored on an
optical-flow interpolation. There is no silent fallback; `blend` is the
only permitted degraded path and must be authored.

FontRef.description:
File hash plus face index fixes the actual bytes; names are verified too.
No family lookup or implicit system-font fallback is permitted.

FrameInterpolation.description:
TRACK-003 (ADR-0123): intermediate-frame synthesis mode attached to a
piecewise retime. Absence keeps the legacy nearest-frame sampling.

oneOf.description: Bidirectional flow warps the neighboring decoded frames.

block_radius.description: Half-size of the matched block; the block spans `2*r+1` pixels.

confidence_floor.description: Per-cell forward/backward consistency confidence floor in `[0, 1]`.

flow_fallback.description: Explicit degraded-mode policy; `None` rejects on low confidence.

levels.description: Pyramid levels including the base image.

search_radius.description: Half-size of the exhaustive search window at the coarsest level.

FrameRate.description: A positive exact number of frames per second.

transform.description: Gradient coordinates to unit coordinates; bbox mapping is applied next.

GradientSpread.description: Versioned paint settings. Missing settings preserve VEC-003 semantics.

interpolation.description: Applies to [this key, next key). Validated even on the last key.

Marker.description:
A single authored annotation in sequence time. Clip markers reference
sequence time (not clip-local source time) and stay inside the clip's
`timeline_range`.

MarkerColor.description: Closed set; transports never guess a color from a label.

MarkerId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

Mask.description:
One authored mask row. Every parameter is a Property reference so paths and
scalars share the existing constant/curve/expression evaluation, evaluated
in sequence time on the clip's lowered node.

closed.description:
Authored path closure. `closed` masks offset as rings; open masks offset
as open chains. Fill coverage itself always closes subpaths.

expansion.description:
Outward (positive) or inward (negative) path offset in clip-local
design_px.

feather.description: Edge blur sigma in clip-local design_px; nonnegative scalar.

invert.description: Inverts this mask's own coverage before the mode combine.

path.description: Bezier path in clip-local design_px; `ValueType::Path` property.

MaskId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

MaskMode.description:
Stack combine order is authored order; coverage composes over the clip's
accumulated alpha. `Add` unions coverage, `Subtract` removes it, `Intersect`
keeps the overlap, and `Difference` keeps the symmetric difference.

visible.description: A consumed matte may also be shown in normal composition draw order.

MediaNode.description: Explicit media stream; AUDIO-003 executes audio only.

time_map.description: Maps time relative to the owning node's active_range.start.

volume.description: A kronello.audio.volume Property owned by the same SceneNode.

Modifier.description:
Ordered modifier frame only, with semantic parameters and a stable identity.
No modifier algorithm or execution capability is implemented here. The
animation compiler must resolve kind/version and reject unsupported kinds.

ModifierId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

asset.description:
Camera media. Resolved against `Project.assets` at validation and
render time; a missing asset is a typed `SOURCE_MISSING` failure.

id.description: Stable UUID identity; never an array index or display name.

name.description: Display label; never used as identity.

stream_index.description: Visual stream inside `asset` that carries this angle's picture.

sync_offset.description:
Angle media time minus multicam-local source time, in rational seconds.
`media_time = multicam_time + sync_offset`; the sign convention is fixed
so `clip.angle_switch` changes only which stream is sampled.

id.description: Stable UUID identity; never an array index or display name.

name.description: Display label; never used as identity.

MulticamId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

NodeKind.description: Content hooks only; geometry, text layout, and rendering are later layers.

Path.description:
A document geometry container only. Topology checking/morph evaluation is
deferred to the vector/animation layer; Path currently supports Hold only.

Property.description:
Deserialization checks intrinsic invariants only; use from_json(input,
registry) or validate(registry) to resolve the descriptor before accepting
an imported property. Source catalogs are checked by validate_sources.

PropertyId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

ProtectedMiddleMode.description: Only the middle is retimed; intro/outro retain unit speed.

job.description: Originating `proxy.generate` job id, when produced by a job.

proxy.description:
The proxy asset; unique across `Project::proxies` and `assets` entries
are still independent (a proxy asset may serve exactly one original).

proxy_stream_index.description: Video stream index inside the proxy asset.

scale.description: Linear scale applied to source dimensions.

source_content_hash.description: Locked `Asset::content_hash` of the original at registration time.

source_duration.description: Locked duration of the original stream, used for duration checks.

width.description: Proxy pixel dimensions (rounded to the encoder's even constraint).

ReframeEasing.description:
Temporal smoothing kernel shape (ADR-0126). The window weight is
`1 - ease(u)` on the normalized offset `u = |dt| / smoothing_window`.

oneOf.description: Tent kernel `1 - u`.
`1 - u^2`: flat near center, sharp window edge.
`(1 - u)^2`: sharp near center, flat window edge.
Smoothstep complement `1 - (3u^2 - 2u^3)`.

instances.description: Array order is draw order only, never identity or random state.

SampleRate.description: Positive integer samples per second. Indices share the time-zero origin.

time.description: Rational source presentation time of the first frame of the new scene.

boundaries.description: Cut boundaries in strictly increasing source time.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the versioned payload; recomputed on validation.

frames_analyzed.description: Decoded frames that produced `boundaries` (provenance, not a lookup).

params.description: Parameters that produced `boundaries`; part of the versioned payload.

SceneDetectionParams.description: Versioned detection parameters baked into the boundary payload hash.

edge_weight.description: Edge-change weight mixed into the histogram difference, in `[0, 1]`.

min_spacing_frames.description: Minimum spacing between emitted boundaries, in sampled frames.

peak_ratio.description: A peak must dominate `peak_ratio * mean` when it misses the sigma band.

child_order.description: Ordered owned children, independent of transform parenting.

enabled.description: Disabled containment subtrees do not enter the evaluated scene.

name.description: Display only; never used as identity.

tags.description: Search metadata only; never runtime identity.

content_hash.description: Locked `Asset::content_hash`; mismatches mark the result stale.

SchemaKey.description:
Immutable namespaced schema identity, such as `kronello.transform.opacity`.
It is supplied by the schema author, independently of a localized label.

markers.description: Sequence-time annotations; bounded by the content extent end.

targets.description:
Implicit destination tracks for edits that take no explicit track, one
per kind. Referenced tracks must exist and match the entry's kind.

work_area.description: In/Out share this range's start/end; absent means the whole sequence.

SequenceId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description: Ordered command correspondence is explicit; no automatic remeshing.
Fractions of concatenated contour arc length; offset wraps modulo one.

SmartReframeRule.description:
AI-003 (ADR-0126): a media node inside a template composition reframed
from the confidence-weighted gaze of a `TrackingDataAsset`. The window is
injected as a layout-derived Vec2 pair through the shared dependency path.

node.description: Media (`Media` or `Null` slot) node inside the placement's composition.

SmartReframeSettings.description:
Versioned smart-reframe settings (ADR-0126): seed selection, temporal
smoothing window, padding, zoom cap and easing are all hash-covered.

max_zoom.description:
`>= 1`: the crop never shrinks below `1 / max_zoom` of the fitted
window (the tightest allowed crop scale).

padding.description:
Gaze margin fraction in `[0, 1]`: `0` is the tightest allowed crop,
`1` the largest target-aspect window fitting the source.

seeds.description:
Selected `TrackingDataAsset::seeds` indexes feeding the gaze centroid;
empty selects every seed in stable order.

smoothing_window.description:
Symmetric temporal smoothing radius in source seconds; zero samples
only frames exactly at the source time.

target_aspect.description: Target crop aspect ratio `width / height` in source pixels.

oneOf.description:
FX-007 (ADR-0116): no payload; the clip applies `effects` to the
composited lower video tracks across its timeline range.

NLE-007 (ADR-0127): one active angle of a `Project.multicams` group.
The clip's local source time lives in multicam-local time; the angle's
`sync_offset` maps it to that angle's media time, so `clip.angle_switch`
re-samples the same multicam interval through another stream.

start_time.description: Absolute PTS origin. Missing legacy metadata means zero, never latest.

options.description: Absent options retain the exact VEC-003 execution path.

StrokeOptions.description: Explicit opt-in; lengths are local design_px, offset is an evaluated Property.

fill_rule.description: Defines the interior independently of whether the shape has fill paint.

TargetTracks.description:
Per-kind implicit edit destinations. A present entry must reference an
existing track of the matching kind; absent means untargeted.

bounds.description: Explicit bounds stage; omitted legacy bindings keep the layout box.

smart_reframes.description:
AI-003 (ADR-0126): tracking-driven crop windows on media nodes, one
layout-derived rule per placement through the shared dependency path.

content_hash.description: Hash of the complete reachable authoring content, fixed by define.

TemplateVariant.description: Each aspect variant freezes a separate authored Composition and bindings.

line_height.description: Absolute baseline spacing in design_px, not a font-size multiplier.

path.description:
Optional `ValueType::Path` Property whose bezier guides glyph baselines.
With a path, `alignment` anchors along path arc length instead of the
wrap box; glyphs past the path end are dropped, not errors.

styles.description: Ordered, nonoverlapping, complete coverage at grapheme boundaries.

TextRange.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte range in the original, unnormalized text.

TimeBezier.description:
Normalized time/value-progress handles between (0, 0) and (1, 1).
Ordered x handles guarantee monotonic time. Finite y handles may overshoot.
These are dimensionless progress values, never stored timestamps.

interpolation.description: TRACK-003: absent keeps the legacy single-frame sample.

TimeRange.description: A half-open interval [start, end). Equal endpoints describe an empty range.

TrackId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description: Text cues rendered above every video track; never enters audio mixing.

TrackState.description:
Authored output switches plus the editing lock; `locked` defaults to off so
documents written before NLE-005 stay unlocked.

locked.description:
Editing lock: mutations that would change this track or its clips are
rejected during planning with `TRACK_LOCKED`.

homography.description:
Plane mode: row-major homography from first-frame normalized
coordinates onto this frame's normalized coordinates.

points.description: One entry per seed (points) or per corner (plane).
